name: Autograph Journey Card
effective_cost: Moderate: the $50 airline credit and travel insurance offset part of the $95 fee, the rest is paid for by the 5x/4x rates if you travel enough
balance_transfer_fee: $5 or 5% of each transfer, whichever is greater

verdict.text: Keep if hotels and airfare are a meaningful share of your spending

earn_rates.category: Other travel: car rentals, cruises, transit

earn_note: The 5x hotel and 4x airline rates are uncapped and among the highest flat rates on a $95-fee card. 'Other travel' (car rentals, cruises, transit) earns the 3x rate alongside restaurants, not the airline or hotel rate.

redemption_options.method: Book travel through the Wells Fargo Rewards portal
Cash redemption (statement credit or account credit)
Pay with Rewards at PayPal checkout
Gift cards from 250+ merchants (e-gift cards from $10)
Transfer to select travel loyalty programs

points.note: Wells Fargo doesn't publish a bonused travel-portal rate, so redemption value stays close to 1 cent per point across cash, portal, and gift-card options. Transfers to loyalty programs exist but Wells Fargo doesn't publish per-partner ratios on its marketing pages, so the effective value there varies by partner and isn't independently confirmed here.

transfer_partners.highlight: Wells Fargo Rewards points can transfer to select airline and hotel loyalty programs, but the current partner list and transfer ratios aren't published on the card's marketing pages; treat the transfer option as unverified until confirmed in the Wells Fargo Rewards portal at account level.

credits.name: Annual Airline Credit
credits.subtitle: $50 · once per year
credits.description: One-time $50 statement credit applied automatically the first time you use the card for an airline purchase of at least $50 in a cardmember year.
tips: Any airline ticket purchase of $50 or more triggers it, so it takes no planning beyond booking one flight a year on this card.

insurance.detail: Up to $15,000 reimbursement per trip for covered cancellations or interruptions
Up to $1,000,000 when the full fare for a common carrier ticket is charged to the card
Up to $3,000 per trip for lost or misdirected baggage
Up to $1,000 per claim against damage, theft, or involuntary separation when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with this card, minus a $25 deductible, max 2 claims per 12 months
Secondary coverage only, applies after your personal auto insurance
Not responsible for unauthorized transactions once reported

protection_note: A real travel insurance suite for a $95 card: trip cancellation up to $15,000, travel accident up to $1,000,000, and baggage coverage all stand out. Cell phone protection is also the richest in the Autograph lineup. No purchase protection or extended warranty are advertised, and rental coverage is secondary only, so those gaps carry over from the no-fee Autograph.
rental_note: Secondary coverage only, meaning it pays after your personal auto policy for whatever's left. Charge the full rental cost to the card and decline the counter's optional CDW to activate it.

services.name: 60,000-point welcome bonus
services.detail: 60,000 bonus points (about $600 toward travel) after spending $4,000 in purchases within the first 3 months.

services.name: No foreign transaction fee
services.detail: $0 on purchases made outside the US.

services.name: Visa Signature Concierge and Luxury Hotel Collection
services.detail: 24/7 concierge for reservations and event tickets, plus perks at select luxury hotel properties.

services.name: Roadside Dispatch
services.detail: 24/7 towing and roadside assistance, billed to the card at time of dispatch, no membership fee.

services.name: My Wells Fargo Deals
services.detail: Personalized merchant offers that earn extra cash back or points as an account credit.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns points on their spend (into your account)

additional_cards.note: No cost to add, and their spending earns the same category rates into your account.

timeline.text: Wells Fargo launches Autograph Journey as a premium companion to Autograph, adding a $95 fee, elevated 5x hotel and 4x airline rates, and a real travel insurance suite (trip cancellation, travel accident, baggage) the no-fee card doesn't have.
